/*=========================================================           STEP 0 : DROP TEMP TABLES         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;           /*=========================================================           STEP 1 : GET BASE ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS         =========================================================*/          SELECT             a.App_Id,             a.App_DisplayId,             a.App_Status,             a.GBA,             a.GBAId,             a.App_MotherEPID,             a.App_Source,              ofi.BtoA_RoadId,             ofi.BtoA_RoadName,              ksr.Road_ID,             ksr.Road_Name,             ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt,              /* EPID Metadata */             b.MD_Zonename,             b.MD_WardName,             b.MD_SiteArea,             b.MD_ZoneId,             b.MD_WardId,             b.MD_StreetId,              /* Officer Details */             o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,             o.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,             o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType          INTO #Apps          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b             ON b.MD_APP_ID = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT                 Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,                 Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,                 Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,                 ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status in (14,1000)             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND b.MD_SiteArea <= 1000             AND ISNULL(ofi.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'             AND ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL 			AND a.App_JCMovedDate is not null             AND a.App_JCMovedDate < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))             AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241) 			AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch, 0) = 0             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired, 0) = 0 			AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType <>'Mixed' and a.App_MotherEPID not in ( 			select epid from KhataBtoA_preprod.dbo.epid_with_mst_plan_use_type700Cases 			)          /*=========================================================           ROAD-WIDENING AREA VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 4                 AND ISNULL(o.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )         )          /*=========================================================           PROPERTY USE TYPE VS MASTER PLAN VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Residential -> ONLY Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential'             )              OR              /* Commercial -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*=========================================================           INDEX TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Apps_AppId         ON #Apps(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000)          GROUP BY             s.Sts_MainAppId          HAVING             MAX(s.Udt) < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));           /*=========================================================           INDEX JC TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JCMovedDate_AppId         ON #JCMovedDate(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 3 : INSERT ONLY NEW ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS            ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          INSERT INTO dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications         (             ApplicationDisplayID,             MotherEPID,             Application_Status,             Corporation,             Zone,             Ward,             IsGovtProperty,             BtoA_RoadId,             BtoA_RoadName,             Road_ID,             Road_Name,             GuidanceValueSqMt,             PropertyUseType,             Application_JCMovedDate,             Application_type,             BtoA_RoadType,             IsMasterPlanMismatch,             SiteArea,             JC_Pending_Days,             CreatedDate,             OfficerName,             IsAutoApprovedManually         )          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status  in (14,1000)                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY         (             SELECT TOP 1                 ofc.Ofcr_Name,                 ofc.Ofcr_Id              FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc              WHERE                 ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId = a.MD_ZoneId                 AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)              ORDER BY                 ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. MUST HAVE AT LEAST ONE ROAD         =========================================================*/          EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id         )           /*=========================================================           2. ALL ROADS MUST BE PUBLIC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND             (                 r.BtoA_RoadType IS NULL                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType)) = ''                 OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType))) <> 'public'             )         )           /*=========================================================           3. EVERY ROAD MUST MATCH KSRAC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND NOT EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_AROMapping aro                  INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC k                     ON k.GBAZONEID = aro.GBAZONEID                     AND k.BBMPWardId = aro.BBMPWardId                     AND k.Road_Active = 1                  WHERE                     aro.GBAZONEID = a.MD_ZoneId                     AND aro.BBMPWardId = a.MD_WardId                     AND aro.BBMPStreetId = a.MD_StreetId                     AND aro.easthiULBNAME_CorpId = a.GBAId                     AND k.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL                     AND k.Road_ID = r.BtoA_RoadId                     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(k.Road_Name))                         = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadName))             )         )           /*=========================================================           4. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. EXCLUDE GOOGLE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteDtls s              WHERE s.Site_App_Id = a.App_Id              AND ISNULL(s.GooglePropertyType, '') = 'govt'         )           /*=========================================================           PREVENT DUPLICATE INSERTS         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications j              WHERE j.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId               AND ISNULL(j.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')         );           /*=========================================================           STEP 4 : UPDATE STATUS TRANSACTION            FINAL UPDATE 2            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE s         SET             s.Sts_PrevStatusId = s.Sts_MainAppStatus,             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 150,             s.Sts_CurrStatusId = 150,             s.Udt = GETDATE(),             s.Sts_comments = 'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             s.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,             s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125,             s.Sts_PrevOfficerId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerId          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000) and a.App_Status in (14,1000)  and a.App_Source='newkhata' 			and isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;     --      /*=========================================================   --        STEP 5 : UPDATE MAIN APPLICATION    --        FINAL UPDATE 3    --        Source applications are identified ONLY from   --        JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications   --      =========================================================*/          UPDATE a         SET             a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved = 1,             a.App_JCApprovedDate = GETDATE(),             a.App_AdditionalInfo =  'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             a.App_Status = 150,             a.App_UDte = GETDATE()          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') =                 ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE a.App_Status in (14,1000) and a.App_Source='newkhata' 		and isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;     --      /*=========================================================   --        STEP 6 : UPDATE TARGET TABLE    --        FINAL UPDATE 1    --        Update only records available in   --        JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications   --      =========================================================*/  		UPDATE b 		SET  		    b.IsAutoApprovedManually = 1 		FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 		INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a 		    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 		    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 		WHERE  		ISNULL(b.IsAutoApprovedManually, 0) = 0 		AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 		AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 		AND a.App_Status = 150 		AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 and  		isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;          /*=========================================================           CLEANUP         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;           COMMIT TRANSACTION;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;          DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);         DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;         DECLARE @ErrorState INT;          SELECT             @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),             @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),             @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();          RAISERROR         (             @ErrorMessage,             @ErrorSeverity,             @ErrorState         );      END CATCH;  	SELECT     a.App_Id,     a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,     a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,     a.App_Status,     a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved,     a.App_JCApprovedDate,     a.App_UDte,     a.App_AdditionalInfo,     b.CreatedDate AS AutoApprovalCreatedDate,     b.IsAutoApprovedManually 	FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a 	INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 	    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 	    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 	WHERE a.App_Status = 150 	  AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 	  AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 	  AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 	ORDER BY a.App_JCApprovedDate DESC;  END

 END

SQL_Text: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_JC_AutoApprove_B2A_Applications] AS BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      BEGIN TRY          BEGIN TRANSACTION;          /*=========================================================           STEP 0 : DROP TEMP TABLES         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;           /*=========================================================           STEP 1 : GET BASE ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS         =========================================================*/          SELECT             a.App_Id,             a.App_DisplayId,             a.App_Status,             a.GBA,             a.GBAId,             a.App_MotherEPID,             a.App_Source,              ofi.BtoA_RoadId,             ofi.BtoA_RoadName,              ksr.Road_ID,             ksr.Road_Name,             ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt,              /* EPID Metadata */             b.MD_Zonename,             b.MD_WardName,             b.MD_SiteArea,             b.MD_ZoneId,             b.MD_WardId,             b.MD_StreetId,              /* Officer Details */             o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,             o.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,             o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType          INTO #Apps          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b             ON b.MD_APP_ID = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT                 Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,                 Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,                 Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,                 ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status = 14             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND b.MD_SiteArea <= 1000             AND ISNULL(ofi.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'             AND ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL 			AND a.App_JCMovedDate is not null             AND a.App_JCMovedDate < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))             AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch, 0) = 0             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired, 0) = 0 			AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType <>'Mixed'          /*=========================================================           ROAD-WIDENING AREA VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 4                 AND ISNULL(o.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )         )          /*=========================================================           PROPERTY USE TYPE VS MASTER PLAN VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Residential -> ONLY Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential'             )              OR              /* Commercial -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*=========================================================           INDEX TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Apps_AppId         ON #Apps(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 14          GROUP BY             s.Sts_MainAppId          HAVING             MAX(s.Udt) < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));           /*=========================================================           INDEX JC TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JCMovedDate_AppId         ON #JCMovedDate(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 3 : INSERT ONLY NEW ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS            ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          INSERT INTO dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         (             ApplicationDisplayID,             MotherEPID,             Application_Status,             Corporation,             Zone,             Ward,             IsGovtProperty,             BtoA_RoadId,             BtoA_RoadName,             Road_ID,             Road_Name,             GuidanceValueSqMt,             PropertyUseType,             Application_JCMovedDate,             Application_type,             BtoA_RoadType,             IsMasterPlanMismatch,             SiteArea,             JC_Pending_Days,             CreatedDate,             OfficerName,             IsAutoApprovedManually         )          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status = 14                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY         (             SELECT TOP 1                 ofc.Ofcr_Name,                 ofc.Ofcr_Id              FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc              WHERE                 ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId = a.MD_ZoneId                 AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)              ORDER BY                 ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. MUST HAVE AT LEAST ONE ROAD         =========================================================*/          EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id         )           /*=========================================================           2. ALL ROADS MUST BE PUBLIC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND             (                 r.BtoA_RoadType IS NULL                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType)) = ''                 OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType))) <> 'public'             )         )           /*=========================================================           3. EVERY ROAD MUST MATCH KSRAC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND NOT EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_AROMapping aro                  INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC k                     ON k.GBAZONEID = aro.GBAZONEID                     AND k.BBMPWardId = aro.BBMPWardId                     AND k.Road_Active = 1                  WHERE                     aro.GBAZONEID = a.MD_ZoneId                     AND aro.BBMPWardId = a.MD_WardId                     AND aro.BBMPStreetId = a.MD_StreetId                     AND aro.easthiULBNAME_CorpId = a.GBAId                     AND k.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL                     AND k.Road_ID = r.BtoA_RoadId                     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(k.Road_Name))                         = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadName))             )         )           /*=========================================================           4. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. EXCLUDE GOOGLE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteDtls s              WHERE s.Site_App_Id = a.App_Id              AND ISNULL(s.GooglePropertyType, '') = 'govt'         )           /*=========================================================           PREVENT DUPLICATE INSERTS         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications j              WHERE j.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId               AND ISNULL(j.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')         );           /*=========================================================           STEP 4 : UPDATE STATUS TRANSACTION            FINAL UPDATE 2            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE s         SET             s.Sts_PrevStatusId = s.Sts_MainAppStatus,             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 150,             s.Sts_CurrStatusId = 150,             s.Udt = GETDATE(),             s.Sts_comments = 'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             s.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,             s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125,             s.Sts_PrevOfficerId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerId          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 14 and a.App_Source<>'newkhata' and  			isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;     --      /*=========================================================   --        STEP 5 : UPDATE MAIN APPLICATION    --        FINAL UPDATE 3    --        Source applications are identified ONLY from   --        JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications   --      =========================================================*/          UPDATE a         SET             a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved = 1,             a.App_JCApprovedDate = GETDATE(),             a.App_AdditionalInfo =  'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             a.App_Status = 150,             a.App_UDte = GETDATE()          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') =                 ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE             a.App_Status = 14 and a.App_Source<>'newkhata'  and  			isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;     --      /*=========================================================   --        STEP 6 : UPDATE TARGET TABLE    --        FINAL UPDATE 1    --        Update only records available in   --        JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications   --      =========================================================*/  		UPDATE b 		SET  		    b.IsAutoApprovedManually = 1 		FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications b 		INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a 		    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 		    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 		WHERE  		ISNULL(b.IsAutoApprovedManually, 0) = 0 		AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 		AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 		AND a.App_Status = 150 		AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 and a.App_Source<>'newkhata' 		 and isnull(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0 and isnull(a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=0;          /*=========================================================           CLEANUP         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;           COMMIT TRANSACTION;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;          DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);         DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;         DECLARE @ErrorState INT;          SELECT             @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),             @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),             @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();          RAISERROR         (             @ErrorMessage,             @ErrorSeverity,             @ErrorState         );      END CATCH;  	SELECT     a.App_Id,     a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,     a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,     a.App_Status,     a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved,     a.App_JCApprovedDate,     a.App_UDte,     a.App_AdditionalInfo,     b.CreatedDate AS AutoApprovalCreatedDate,     b.IsAutoApprovedManually 	FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a 	INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications b 	    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 	    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 	WHERE a.App_Status = 150 	  AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 	  AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 	  AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 	ORDER BY a.App_JCApprovedDate DESC;  END

SQL_Text: ALTER PROC [dbo].[USP_U_QC_TO_BTOA_SCH] AS BEGIN    SET XACT_ABORT ON;    BEGIN TRY       BEGIN TRAN;           ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 1. Update Site Road Details          ------------------------------------------------------------           UPDATE ff          SET             TotalPlotArea                   = JSON_VALUE(d.MD_JSON, '$.SiteDetails.SiteArea'),             PlotRMPWidnedAreainSqmt         = 0                                              ,             PlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt = JSON_VALUE(d.MD_JSON, '$.SiteDetails.SiteArea'),             ArchitectRemarks                = 'By Schedular Moved to Joint Commissioner'     ,             UDte                            = GETDATE()          FROM BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ff          INNER JOIN (select Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId from  BtoA_MainApp_Officer) a ON ff.BtoA_MainAppId = a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN BtoAMainApp b ON a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = b.App_Id          INNER JOIN BtoA_Gps_ArchitectDetails_Officer c on b.App_Id=c.App_Id          inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData d on ff.BtoA_MainAppId=d.MD_APP_ID          WHERE b.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18) and b.App_Active=1 and ISNULL(c.RoadWideningProposedInRmp,0)= 0  		 and  b.App_Id not in(8105,16380,26190,44989,11887) and  		 TotalPlotArea<>JSON_VALUE(d.MD_JSON, '$.SiteDetails.SiteArea');            ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 2. Update Plot Areas          ------------------------------------------------------------           UPDATE a          SET             ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt =             CASE                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedResidentialArea,0)                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedResidentialArea,0)                ELSE Ofcr_CorrectedResidentialArea             END,             CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt =             CASE                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedCommercialArea,0)                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedCommercialArea,0)                ELSE Ofcr_CorrectedCommercialArea             END,             IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt =             CASE                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_Corrected_IndustrialArea,0)                ELSE Ofcr_Corrected_IndustrialArea             END          FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer a          inner join BtoAMainApp b on a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId=b.App_Id          WHERE Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue IN ('Residential','Commercial','Industrial','Mixed')          AND Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId in (1,2,3,4)          AND b.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18) and  b.App_Id not in(8105,16380,26190,44989,11887)          and b.App_Active=1; 		 --and App_Id=860;            --------------------------------------------------------------          ---- 3. Update Property Verification Required          --------------------------------------------------------------          UPDATE             a          SET             IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired = 1          FROM BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN             BtoA_MainApp_Officer o          ON             a.App_Id = o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN             [BtoA_SiteDtls] s          ON             a.App_Id        = s.Site_App_Id          WHERE a.App_Active = 1          AND a.App_Status IN (12,13,16,18,15,1000,1110)          AND (                isnull(o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,0)   = 1                OR s.GooglePropertyType = 'govt')          and isnull(a.App_PropertyVerified,0)=0 and isnull(IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0          and a.App_Active=1;          --------------------------------------------------------------          ---- 4. Update Master Plan Mismatch Flag          --------------------------------------------------------------  		UPDATE BA 		SET IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch = 			CASE 				-- Missing values 				WHEN ISNULL(MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue, '') = '' 				  OR ISNULL(MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType, '') = '' 				THEN 1  				-- Valid combinations 				WHEN 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential' 					) 					OR 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN 							('Residential', 'Commercial') 					) 					OR 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN 							('Residential', 'Industrial') 					) 					OR 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN 							('Residential', 'Commercial') 					) 				THEN 0  				-- All other combinations 				ELSE 1 			END 		FROM BtoAMainApp BA 		INNER JOIN (select KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType,Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue, Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppID from BtoA_MainApp_Officer) MO 			ON BA.App_Id = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId 		WHERE BA.App_Active = 1 		  AND BA.App_Status IN (12, 13,15, 16, 18,1000,1110) 		  AND ISNULL(BA.App_MasterPlanMismatchVerified, 0) = 0  		  and BA.App_MotherEPID not in(select EPID from KhataBtoA_preprod.dbo.epid_with_mst_plan_use_type700Cases) ;            ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 5. Update Status Transaction(BtoA)          ------------------------------------------------------------          UPDATE             ff          SET             Sts_PrevStatusId  = Sts_MainAppStatus,             Sts_CurrStatusId  = 14,             Sts_MainAppStatus = 14,             Sts_comments = 'By Schedular Moved to JC',             Udt = GETDATE()          FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran ff          INNER JOIN (select Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId from BtoA_MainApp_Officer) a ON ff.Sts_MainAppId = a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN BtoAMainApp b ON a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = b.App_Id          WHERE b.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18)          AND isnull(b.App_Source,'') <> 'newkhata'          and b.App_Active = 1;            ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 6. Update Main Application          ------------------------------------------------------------          UPDATE a          SET             App_Status = 14                                        ,             App_AdditionalInfo = 'By Schedular Moved to Joint Commissioner',             App_JCMovedDate =getdate()                                  ,             App_UDte = GETDATE()          FROM BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN (select Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId from BtoA_MainApp_Officer) o ON a.App_Id = o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          WHERE a.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18) and a.App_Active=1          AND a.App_Source <> 'newkhata';        COMMIT TRAN;    END TRY BEGIN CATCH    ROLLBACK TRAN;    THROW; END CATCH  END

Update Site Road Details          ------------------------------------------------------------           UPDATE ff          SET             TotalPlotArea                   = JSON_VALUE(d.MD_JSON, '$.SiteDetails.SiteArea'),             PlotRMPWidnedAreainSqmt         = 0                                              ,             PlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt = JSON_VALUE(d.MD_JSON, '$.SiteDetails.SiteArea'),             ArchitectRemarks                = 'By Schedular Moved to Joint Commissioner'     ,             UDte                            = GETDATE()          FROM BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ff          INNER JOIN (select Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId from  BtoA_MainApp_Officer) a ON ff.BtoA_MainAppId = a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN BtoAMainApp b ON a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = b.App_Id          INNER JOIN BtoA_Gps_ArchitectDetails_Officer c on b.App_Id=c.App_Id          inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData d on ff.BtoA_MainAppId=d.MD_APP_ID          WHERE b.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18) and b.App_Active=1 and ISNULL(c.RoadWideningProposedInRmp,0)= 0  		 and  b.App_Id not in(8105,16380,26190,44989,11887) and  		 TotalPlotArea<>JSON_VALUE(d.MD_JSON, '$.SiteDetails.SiteArea');            ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 2. Update Plot Areas          ------------------------------------------------------------           UPDATE a          SET             ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt =             CASE                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedResidentialArea,0)                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedResidentialArea,0)                ELSE Ofcr_CorrectedResidentialArea             END,             CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt =             CASE                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedCommercialArea,0)                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_CorrectedCommercialArea,0)                ELSE Ofcr_CorrectedCommercialArea             END,             IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt =             CASE                WHEN                   Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                THEN ISNULL(Ofcr_Corrected_IndustrialArea,0)                ELSE Ofcr_Corrected_IndustrialArea             END          FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer a          inner join BtoAMainApp b on a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId=b.App_Id          WHERE Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue IN ('Residential','Commercial','Industrial','Mixed')          AND Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId in (1,2,3,4)          AND b.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18) and  b.App_Id not in(8105,16380,26190,44989,11887)          and b.App_Active=1; 		 --and App_Id=860;            --------------------------------------------------------------          ---- 3. Update Property Verification Required          --------------------------------------------------------------          UPDATE             a          SET             IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired = 1          FROM BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN             BtoA_MainApp_Officer o          ON             a.App_Id = o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN             [BtoA_SiteDtls] s          ON             a.App_Id        = s.Site_App_Id          WHERE a.App_Active = 1          AND a.App_Status IN (12,13,16,18,15,1000,1110)          AND (                isnull(o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,0)   = 1                OR s.GooglePropertyType = 'govt')          and isnull(a.App_PropertyVerified,0)=0 and isnull(IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=0          and a.App_Active=1;          --------------------------------------------------------------          ---- 4. Update Master Plan Mismatch Flag          --------------------------------------------------------------  		UPDATE BA 		SET IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch = 			CASE 				-- Missing values 				WHEN ISNULL(MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue, '') = '' 				  OR ISNULL(MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType, '') = '' 				THEN 1  				-- Valid combinations 				WHEN 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential' 					) 					OR 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN 							('Residential', 'Commercial') 					) 					OR 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN 							('Residential', 'Industrial') 					) 					OR 					( 						MO.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed' 						AND MO.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN 							('Residential', 'Commercial') 					) 				THEN 0  				-- All other combinations 				ELSE 1 			END 		FROM BtoAMainApp BA 		INNER JOIN (select KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType,Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue, Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppID from BtoA_MainApp_Officer) MO 			ON BA.App_Id = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId 		WHERE BA.App_Active = 1 		  AND BA.App_Status IN (12, 13,15, 16, 18,1000,1110) 		  AND ISNULL(BA.App_MasterPlanMismatchVerified, 0) = 0;            ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 5. Update Status Transaction(BtoA)          ------------------------------------------------------------          UPDATE             ff          SET             Sts_PrevStatusId  = Sts_MainAppStatus,             Sts_CurrStatusId  = 14,             Sts_MainAppStatus = 14,             Sts_comments = 'By Schedular Moved to JC',             Udt = GETDATE()          FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran ff          INNER JOIN (select Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId from BtoA_MainApp_Officer) a ON ff.Sts_MainAppId = a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN BtoAMainApp b ON a.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = b.App_Id          WHERE b.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18)          AND isnull(b.App_Source,'') <> 'newkhata'          and b.App_Active = 1;            ------------------------------------------------------------          -- 6. Update Main Application          ------------------------------------------------------------          UPDATE a          SET             App_Status = 14                                        ,             App_AdditionalInfo = 'By Schedular Moved to Joint Commissioner',             App_JCMovedDate =getdate()                                  ,             App_UDte = GETDATE()          FROM BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN (select Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId from BtoA_MainApp_Officer) o ON a.App_Id = o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          WHERE a.App_Status IN (13,15,16,18) and a.App_Active=1          AND a.App_Source <> 'newkhata';        COMMIT TRAN;    END TRY BEGIN CATCH    ROLLBACK TRAN;    THROW; END CATCH  END

 			     			  	UPDATE MA SET Ofcr_Existing_IsGovtProperty=Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 			MA.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty = CASE WHEN @Conclusion = 'Government' THEN 1  			WHEN @Conclusion = 'Private' THEN 0 END, MA.UDte = GETDATE(),  			MA.Ofcr_Aditional = ISNULL(MA.Ofcr_Aditional, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(MA.Ofcr_Aditional, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' '  			END + 'Property is Concluded by JC: ' + @Conclusion  			FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer MA WHERE MA.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = @App_Id AND @Conclusion IN ('Government', 'Private');   			 			SELECT 				NULL AS Exception, 				CONVERT(BIT, 1) AS Status, 				CASE  					WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(@Conclusion)) IN ('Private Land', 'Government Land') 					THEN 'The property has been verified successfully' 					ELSE 'The property has been verified successfully' 				END AS MessageToDisplay, 				200 AS responseCode; 			END 		END  	else if(@Level =2 )  --Master Pland and RI Corrected Property use type Correction 		BEGIN         INSERT INTO BtoA_JC_Conclusion_GovtLand_MstPlan         (             App_Id,             Conclusion,             Remarks,             CDte,             CRole,             CBy, 			isActive   		         )         VALUES         (             @App_Id,             @Conclusion,             @Remarks,             GETDATE(),             @CRole,             @CBy, 			1           ); 	END 		END  		else 		begin 		 select ERROR_MESSAGE() as Exception, CONVERT(bit, 0 ) as Status,  'invalid level is passed for this application'  as MessageToDisplay, 400 as responseCode 		end          COMMIT TRANSACTION;      IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status in (14,1000)             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*========================================================= /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id =        ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          INSERT INTO    OfficerName,             IsAutoApprovedManually         )          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status  in (14,1000)                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. SM with (nolock) on MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId=SM.Sts_MainAppId       Left JOIN BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer RD ON MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId= RD.BtoA_MainAppId                 WHERE                      Sts_CurrStatusId in (42) AND RD.BtoA_RoadType IN ( SELECT TRIM(value) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@RoadTypeValue, ','))) AS CompletedCount,          (SELECT COUNT(*)                 FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO with (nolock) inner join BtoA_Status_Master_Tran SM with (nolock) on MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId=SM.Sts_MainAppId                WHERE 1=0) AS PrivateRoadCount,         Convert(int,0)  AS ObjectedCount,        Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount     end             END        ELSE IF @p_Level = 2  --@Corp is passed Commissioner       BEGIN     if @p_Corp is not null     begin          WITH BaseData AS   (       SELECT distinct           MA.App_Id,           MA.App_Status,           SM.Sts_CurrStatusId,           SM.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,           MD.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea       FROM BtoAMainApp MA       INNER JOIN BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO            ON MA.App_Id = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId       inner JOIN BtoA_Status_Master_Tran SM            ON MA.App_Id = SM.Sts_MainAppId            AND MA.App_Status = SM.Sts_MainAppStatus       INNER JOIN BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD            ON MA.App_Id = MD.MD_APP_ID            WHERE MA.App_Active=1  AND  MA.GBAId = @p_Corp   AND EXISTS (           SELECT 1            FROM BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer RD           WHERE RD.BtoA_MainAppId = MA.App_Id) and (App_Status in(200, 300,1100,1500) OR ( Sts_MainAppStatus = 11 AND Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130)       )   )      SELECT       -- ✅ All Count       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN App_Status IN (11,200,300,1500,1100)           THEN App_Id END) AS AllCount,          -- ✅ Pending Count       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN Sts_CurrStatusId IN (1500,1100)           THEN App_Id END) AS PendingCount,          -- ✅ Rejected Count (ONLY for specific RoleId)       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN Sts_CurrStatusId = 11                 AND Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130   --�� role condition applied           THEN App_Id END) AS RejectedCount,          -- ✅ Recommended Count       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN Sts_CurrStatusId IN (1100,1500)           THEN App_Id END) AS RecommendedCount,          -- ✅ Completed Count       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN Sts_CurrStatusId IN (200,300)           THEN App_Id END) AS CompletedCount,          -- Static values       CONVERT(INT,0) AS PrivateRoadCount,       CONVERT(INT,0) AS ObjectedCount,    Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount      FROM BaseData;     end             END          ELSE IF @p_Level = 3 --architect     BEGIN        print @p_Level     print 'print '            select PendingCount,RejectedCount,CompletedCount,RecommendedCount,(PendingCount+RejectedCount+CompletedCount) Allcount,PrivateRoadCount,     Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount from (     SELECT             --(select count(*) from BtoAMainApp where app_id not in( select distinct appid from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp where isActive=1) and      --app_Status in(13,14,200,300) and GBAId=@p_Corp     --    ) AS AllCount,             -- PendingCount: Status 13 and NOT assigned to ANY architect      ( select count(*) from BtoAMainApp where app_id not in( select appid from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp where isActive=1 )      and app_Status in(13)   and GBAId=@p_Corp      ) AS PendingCount,             -- AssignedToMeCount: Status 13 and assigned to current architect      (SELECT COUNT(*)       FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO       INNER JOIN BtoA_Status_Master_Tran SM        ON MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = SM.Sts_MainAppId       INNER JOIN BtoAMainApp MA        ON MA.App_Id = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId       LEFT JOIN BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer SRD         ON SRD.BtoA_MainAppId = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId       WHERE MA.App_Active=1  AND  SM.Sts_CurrStatusId = 13         AND MA.GBAId = @p_Corp          AND SRD.BtoA_RoadType = 'Public'         AND EXISTS (          SELECT 1          FROM BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp AA          WHERE AA.AppId = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId         AND AA.Arch_Id = @p_ArchId          AND AA.IsActive = 1         ) AND SRD.BtoA_RoadType IN (     SELECT TRIM(value)     FROM STRING_SPLIT(@RoadTypeValue, ','))      ) AS RejectedCount,             ( select distinct count(*) from BtoAMainApp MA with(nolock)       inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MAO with(nolock) On MA.App_Id=MAO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId       inner Join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD with(nolock) On MA.App_Id=MD.MD_APP_ID       inner join BtoA_Status_Master_Tran STS with(nolock) On MA.App_Id=STS.Sts_MainAppId and Sts.Sts_MainAppStatus=MA.App_Status              Left JOIN BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer RD ON MA.app_ID = RD.BtoA_MainAppId where MA.App_Active=1  AND MA.GBAId=@p_Corp and MD.MD_ZoneId=@p_Zone and  sts.Sts_CurrStatusId   in (1500)       AND RD.BtoA_RoadType IN ( SELECT TRIM(value) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@RoadTypeValue, ','))       ) AS RecommendedCount,            -- CompletedCount: Status 14 (either not assigned OR assigned to current architect)      (    SELECT count(*)       FROM BtoAMainApp MA       inner Join BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer RD on RD.BtoA_MainAppId=MA.App_id       WHERE MA.App_status in(11, 14,200,300)         AND MA.GBAId = @p_Corp                AND  MA.App_id in         (         select Appid from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp where isActive=1 and Arch_id=@p_ArchId         )        AND RD.BtoA_RoadType IN ( SELECT TRIM(value) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@RoadTypeValue, ','))                ) AS CompletedCount,            Convert(int,0)  AS PrivateRoadCount,      Convert(int,0)  AS ObjectedCount      ) as Final;       END      ELSE IF @p_Level = 4 --Case Worker Login     BEGIN       WITH AppData AS   (       SELECT            MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,           SM.Sts_CurrStatusId,           SM.Sts_MainAppStatus,              -- ✅ Flag: if any private road exists           MAX(CASE                WHEN RD.BtoA_RoadType = 'Private' THEN 1                ELSE 0            END) AS HasPrivateRoad,              CASE                WHEN OBJ.Obj_AppId IS NOT NULL THEN 1                ELSE 0            END AS IsObjected          FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO          INNER JOIN BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD            ON MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = MD.MD_APP_ID          INNER JOIN BtoAMainApp MA            ON MA.App_Id = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          INNER JOIN BtoA_Status_Master_Tran SM            ON MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = SM.Sts_MainAppId          INNER JOIN BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer RD            ON RD.BtoA_MainAppId = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          LEFT JOIN Khata_Obj_MainApp OBJ           ON OBJ.Obj_AppId = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId          WHERE MA.App_Active=1  AND            MA.GBAId = @p_Corp           AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone           AND MD.MD_WardId = @p_Ward           AND MA.App_Source = 'NewKhata'          GROUP BY            MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,           SM.Sts_CurrStatusId,           SM.Sts_MainAppStatus,           OBJ.Obj_AppId   )      SELECT       SUM(CASE WHEN Sts_MainAppStatus IN (13,18,16,12)           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AllCount,          SUM(CASE WHEN Sts_MainAppStatus IN (13,18,16,12)            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PendingCount,          CONVERT(int,0) AS RejectedCount,          SUM(CASE WHEN Sts_MainAppStatus IN (1000,1110,150,200,300,1500,1100)            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RecommendedCount,          CONVERT(int,0) AS CompletedCount,          -- ✅ Only applications having at least one private road       SUM(CASE WHEN HasPrivateRoad = 1            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PrivateRoadCount,          SUM(CASE WHEN IsObjected = 1            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ObjectedCount,    Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount      FROM AppData                END        ELSE IF @p_Level = 5  --Joint Commissioner is passed       BEGIN     if @p_Corp is not null     begin            ;WITH LatestHist AS (     SELECT Sts_MainAppId,Sts_CurrStatusId,Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,Sts_TranId,Sts_TranId_HistId,                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                  PARTITION BY Sts_MainAppId                   ORDER BY Sts_TranId_HistId DESC              ) AS RN       FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran_Hist   ),      LatestStatus AS (      SELECT Sts_MainAppId,Sts_CurrStatusId,Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,Sts_TranId,Udt,Sts_MainAppStatus,              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                  PARTITION BY Sts_MainAppId                   ORDER BY Udt DESC, Sts_TranId DESC              ) AS RN       FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran   ),      LatestOfficer AS (    SELECT Ofcr_RowId, Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId, ApplicationDisplayId,PropertyId,ApplicationDate,SsaId,              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                  PARTITION BY Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId                  ORDER BY Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId DESC              ) AS RN       FROM BtoA_MainApp_Officer   ),      BaseData AS (       SELECT            MA.App_Id,           MA.App_Status,           LS.Sts_CurrStatusId,           LS.Sts_MainAppStatus,           LS.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,              LH.Sts_CurrStatusId AS HistStatus,           LH.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId AS HistRoleId,              -- ✅ GV FLAG          CAST(ISNULL(GV.GVFlag,0) AS BIT) AS GVFlag        FROM BtoAMainApp MA          INNER JOIN LatestOfficer MO           ON MA.App_Id = MO.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId           AND MO.RN = 1          INNER JOIN LatestStatus LS           ON MA.App_Id = LS.Sts_MainAppId           AND LS.RN = 1          INNER JOIN BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD            ON MA.App_Id = MD.MD_APP_ID          LEFT JOIN LatestHist LH            ON MA.App_Id = LH.Sts_MainAppId           AND LH.RN = 1     OUTER APPLY     (      SELECT TOP (1)       CAST(        CASE         WHEN ISNULL(R.GuidanceValueSqMt,0) > 0         THEN 1         ELSE 0        END AS BIT       ) AS GVFlag      FROM BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer SR      INNER JOIN MASTERDB_PROD.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC R       ON SR.BtoA_RoadId = R.Road_ID      INNER JOIN MASTERDB_PROD.dbo.mst_AROMapping AM       ON MD.MD_ZoneId   = AM.GBAZoneID         AND MD.MD_WardId   = AM.BBMPWardId         AND MD.MD_StreetId = AM.BBMPStreetId      WHERE SR.BtoA_MainAppId = MA.App_Id        AND SR.BtoA_RoadId IS NOT NULL      ORDER BY R.GuidanceValueSqMt     ) GV       WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp         AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone            AND EXISTS (               SELECT 1               FROM BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer RD               WHERE RD.BtoA_MainAppId = MA.App_Id         )            AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)       AND isnull(MA.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0) = 0 and isnull(MA.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0) =0      AND MA.App_Active=1        AND     (         -- Show applications that are not assigned         NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp AA             WHERE AA.AppId = MA.App_Id               AND AA.IsActive = 1         )            -- Or show if assigned to the logged-in officer         OR EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp AA             WHERE AA.AppId = MA.App_Id               AND AA.Arch_Id = @p_ArchId               AND AA.Arch_Role = @p_Role               AND AA.IsActive = 1         )     )      )            SELECT          -- ✅ ALL COUNT       COUNT(DISTINCT App_Id) AS AllCount,          -- ✅ PENDING       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN App_Status IN (14,12,1000,1110)           THEN App_Id        END) AS PendingCount,          -- ✅ APPROVED       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN App_Status = 150                OR (                    App_Status IN (200,300)                    OR (HistStatus IN (150,1500,1100)                         AND Sts_MainAppStatus NOT IN (14))                )           THEN App_Id        END) AS CompletedCount,          -- ✅ RECOMMENDED       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN App_Status IN (1500,1100)                OR (                    HistStatus IN (1500,1100)                    AND HistRoleId = 125                    AND App_Status IN (200,300)                )           THEN App_Id        END) AS RecommendedCount,          -- ✅ REJECTED       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN App_Status IN (110)                AND Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125           THEN App_Id        END) AS RejectedCount,          -- ✅ GV ZERO COUNT       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE            WHEN GVFlag = 0           THEN App_Id        END) AS GVZeroCount,        -- Static columns       0 AS PrivateRoadCount,       0 AS ObjectedCount         FROM BaseData           end             END          ELSE IF @p_Level = 6 --Joint Commissioner Property Verification Required      BEGIN        SELECT       (select count(*) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired=1     ) AS ALLCOUNT,              (select count(*) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id      WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and isnull(IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=1 and  App_PropertyVerified=0) AS PendingCount ,                 (select count(*) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id      WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired=1 and  App_PropertyVerified=1) AS RejectedCount,                     (select count(*) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id      WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (1500,1100)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired=1 and  App_PropertyVerified=1       ) AS RecommendedCount,                   (select count(*) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id      WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (150)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and isnull(IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired,0)=1 and  App_PropertyVerified=1) AS CompletedCount,   Convert(int,0)   AS PrivateRoadCount,   Convert(int,0)  AS ObjectedCount,   Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount         END       ELSE IF @p_Level = 7  --Joint Commissione Master Plan Verification Required    BEGIN         SELECT    (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and   isnull(IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=1      ) AS ALLCOUNT,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and   isnull(IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=1 and isnull(App_MasterPlanMismatchVerified,0)=0 ) AS PendingCount ,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and   isnull(IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=1 and isnull(App_MasterPlanMismatchVerified,0)=1 ) AS RejectedCount,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (1500,1100)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and  isnull(IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=1 and isnull(App_MasterPlanMismatchVerified,0)=1       ) AS RecommendedCount,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (150)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and  isnull(IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch,0)=1 and isnull(App_MasterPlanMismatchVerified,0)=1) AS CompletedCount,   Convert(int,0)   AS PrivateRoadCount,   Convert(int,0)  AS ObjectedCount,   Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount         END     ELSE IF @p_Level = 8  --Joint Commissione Area Verification Required    BEGIN         SELECT    (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and   isnull(isApp_AreaVerificationRequired,0)=1      ) AS ALLCOUNT,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (12,110,14,150,200,300,1100,1500,1000,1110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and   isnull(isApp_AreaVerificationRequired,0)=1 and isnull(App_AreaVerified,0)=0 ) AS PendingCount ,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (110)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and   isnull(isApp_AreaVerificationRequired,0)=1 and isnull(App_AreaVerified,0)=1 ) AS RejectedCount,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (1500,1100)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and  isnull(isApp_AreaVerificationRequired,0)=1 and isnull(App_AreaVerified,0)=1       ) AS RecommendedCount,      (select count(distinct Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId) from BtoAMainApp MA   inner join BtoA_MainApp_Officer MO on MA.app_id=Mo.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId   inner join BtoA_EPIDMetaData MD on MD.MD_APP_ID=ma.App_Id   WHERE MA.GBAId = @p_Corp     AND MD.MD_ZoneId = @p_Zone     AND MA.App_Status IN (150)     AND MA.App_Active = 1 and  isnull(isApp_AreaVerificationRequired,0)=1 and isnull(App_AreaVerified,0)=1) AS CompletedCount,   Convert(int,0)   AS PrivateRoadCount,   Convert(int,0)  AS ObjectedCount,   Convert(int,0) AS GVZeroCount         END      END

SQL_Text: ALTER   PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_IU_BtoA_JC_SiteDimension] (     @SiteDim_id             INT = NULL,     @SiteDim_Siteid         INT = NULL,     @SiteDim_AppId          INT = NULL,     @SiteDim_SideInFt       DECIMAL(18,2) = NULL,     @SiteDim_SideInMt       DECIMAL(18,2) = NULL,     @SiteDim_RoadFacing     INT = NULL,     @SiteDim_Active         BIT = NULL,     @SiteDim_Remarks        NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,     @SiteDim_AdditionalInfo NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,     @SiteDim_IPAddress      NVARCHAR(16) = NULL,     @SiteDim_CBy            NVARCHAR(10) = NULL,     @SiteDim_CName          NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL,     @SiteDim_CRole          NVARCHAR(200) = NULL ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      BEGIN TRY          IF ISNULL(@SiteDim_id, 0) = 0         BEGIN             -- INSERT             INSERT INTO [dbo].[BtoA_JC_SiteDimension]             (                 [SiteDim_Siteid],                 [SiteDim_AppId],                 [SiteDim_SideInFt],                 [SiteDim_SideInMt],                 [SiteDim_RoadFacing],                 [SiteDim_Active],                 [SiteDim_Remarks],                 [SiteDim_AdditionalInfo],                 [SiteDim_IPAddress],                 [SiteDim_CBy],                 [SiteDim_CName],                 [SiteDim_CRole],                 [SiteDim_CDate]             )             VALUES             (                 @SiteDim_Siteid,                 @SiteDim_AppId,                 @SiteDim_SideInFt,                 @SiteDim_SideInMt,                 @SiteDim_RoadFacing,                 ISNULL(@SiteDim_Active, 1),                 @SiteDim_Remarks,                 @SiteDim_AdditionalInfo,                 @SiteDim_IPAddress,                 @SiteDim_CBy,                 @SiteDim_CName,                 @SiteDim_CRole,                 GETDATE()             );              SET @SiteDim_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY();               SELECT             @SiteDim_Siteid AS SiteID,  			'Success' AS Message,             cast(1 as bit) as Status, 		    @SiteDim_id as SiteDim_id          END         ELSE         BEGIN             -- UPDATE             UPDATE [dbo].[BtoA_JC_SiteDimension]             SET                 [SiteDim_Siteid]         = @SiteDim_Siteid,                 [SiteDim_AppId]          = @SiteDim_AppId,                 [SiteDim_SideInFt]       = @SiteDim_SideInFt,                 [SiteDim_SideInMt]       = @SiteDim_SideInMt,                 [SiteDim_RoadFacing]     = @SiteDim_RoadFacing,                 [SiteDim_Active]         = @SiteDim_Active,                 [SiteDim_Remarks]        = @SiteDim_Remarks,                 [SiteDim_AdditionalInfo] = @SiteDim_AdditionalInfo,                 [SiteDim_IPAddress]      = @SiteDim_IPAddress,                 [SiteDim_UBy]            = @SiteDim_CBy,                 [SiteDim_UName]          = @SiteDim_CName,                 [SiteDim_URole]          = @SiteDim_CRole,                 [SiteDim_UDate]          = GETDATE()             WHERE [SiteDim_id] = @SiteDim_id;              IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0             BEGIN                    SELECT             @SiteDim_Siteid AS SiteID,'Error ' AS Message,             cast(0 as bit) as Status, 		    @SiteDim_id as SiteDim_id             END             ELSE             BEGIN            SELECT             @SiteDim_Siteid AS SiteID,  			'Success' AS Message,             cast(1 as bit) as Status, 		    @SiteDim_id as SiteDim_id             END         END      END TRY     BEGIN CATCH            SELECT             @SiteDim_Siteid AS SiteID,  			ERROR_MESSAGE() AS Message,             cast(0 as bit) as Status, 		    @SiteDim_id as SiteDim_id      END CATCH END;
